notes.title: BIG VALIUPDATE!
notes.content:
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR56amWYAAedR-?format=jpg&name=large

ValiDate has a big update coming this December!

New features:

 Rhythm mini-game 🎶
 Auto-Save 💾
 Skip to the next choice button ⏩
 Updated character outfits 👗
 Different font options 👓
 End card indicators
 Hot-keys


Fixes:


 Typos
 Sprite fixes
 Fishing Mini Game randomizer 


RHYTHM MINI-GAME

ValiDate's rhythm mini-game allows players to play as Malik as he DJs his set for the gala in the MalikRocky route! 🎶

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR8UnTWIBMizAb?format=jpg&name=large
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR8hEjWIAYSNpt?format=jpg&name=large

Players will have a choice to play:


 Coochie Man
 Yo Gabba Gabba
 Malik's Anthem


https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR8fY9WQAAKREc?format=jpg&name=large

AUTO-SAVE

Auto-save is coming to ValiDate!

At every choice, the game automatically saves! 💾

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR-DB9XkAA-MEc?format=jpg&name=large
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR-EoDWYAAkUUh?format=jpg&name=large

Skip to next choice button!

Players are given the option to skip choices to get their desired endings!

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiR-bRbXgAEPIDA?format=jpg&name=small

Different font options!

Players have a choice of:


 Dosis (original font)
 Open Dyslexic 
 Roboto

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSCnl4WIAgyODN?format=jpg&name=large
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSCqdhaEAAKQSe?format=jpg&name=large
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSCsXVXoAY8O9S?format=jpg&name=large

End card indicators

We added end-card indicators to let players know what ending they got!

The good, bad and rare ending for the MalikArihi route!

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSDzCGWIAITZ96?format=jpg&name=large
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSDz4uWIA44KtO?format=jpg&name=large
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FiSD0ZIWIAgnKNV?format=jpg&name=large

Along with a few more quality-of-life, typo, and bug fixes!

Thank you for all of the love and support for ValiDate; we really appreciate it!💗

notes.title: Major update 9-25-2022
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We just had a major Steam Update that should fix every issue you have with the game. Please update your game!


What we fixed:


 Added cloud save to fix save issues after update.
 Content warning list to the main menu (a button will be added to the options menu in a future update).
 Prologue at a lower volume.



As always, any remaining bugs or typos can be submitted here! Thank you all for being so patient with us as we figure things out, we really appreciate it!

notes.title: Major update 8-24-2022
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We just had a major Steam Update that should fix every issue you have with the game. Please update your game!


What we fixed:


 Load time is faster, like a lot faster. We are looking at a ~40-50% cut load time to boot up the game. 
 Added the sprite to Inaya's CG gallery  
 Fixed some typos.
 Fixed sprite missing errors and positioning for all characters 
 Side character introductions no longer cause sprites to go missing. 
 Updated Fishing mini-game. 
 Updated the phone to remove the contacts button since it is currently not working.



As always, any remaining bugs or typos can be submitted here! Thank you all for being so patient with us as we figure things out, we really appreciate it!
